题三.

$$\left\{ \vec{v} = \dot{x}\vec{e}_x + \dot{y}\vec{e}_y,\ \vec{B} = B_0\vec{e}_z,\ \vec{E} = E\vec{e}_y \right\}$$

$$m\ddot{x} = qB_0\dot{y}$$

![](data/images/2025-2b03dcc6/2025-兰阶-暑假-第二套-答案-25.jpg)

$$m\ddot{y} = -qB_0\dot{x} + qE$$

$$\Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{aligned} \ddot{x} &= \omega_0\dot{y} \\ \ddot{y} &= -\omega_0(\dot{x} - E/B_0) \end{aligned} \right.$$

$$\left( \omega_0 = \frac{qB_0}{m} \right)$$

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} \dot{x} &= \dot{x}_0 + E/B_0 \\ \dot{y} &= \dot{y}_0 \end{aligned} \right. \Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{aligned} \ddot{x}_0 &= \omega_0\dot{y}_0 \\ \ddot{y}_0 &= -\omega_0\dot{x}_0 \end{aligned} \right. \Rightarrow \cdots \Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{aligned} \dot{x}_0 &= v_0\sin\omega_0 t \\ \dot{y}_0 &= v_0\cos\omega_0 t \end{aligned} \right.$$

—代表圆周运动

$$\dot{x} = v_0\sin\omega_0 t + E/B_0$$

$$\dot{y} = v_0\cos\omega_0 t$$

$$\vec{v} = \dot{x}\vec{e}_x + \dot{y}\vec{e}_y = \dot{x}_0\vec{e}_x + \dot{y}_0\vec{e}_y + \frac{E}{B_0}\vec{e}_x = \vec{v}_{回旋} + \vec{v}_{漂移}$$

$$\overline{\vec{v}} = \overline{\vec{v}}_{回旋} + \overline{\vec{v}}_p = \overline{\vec{v}}_p$$

漂移速度: $v_p = \frac{E}{B_0}\vec{e}_x$

(A:一个圆周运动周期内的平均值)

$$(1)(2) \Rightarrow B_y = B_y(z)$$

$$\frac{\partial B_y}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial B_x}{\partial y} = 0$$

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} & q\vec{v} \times \vec{B} = m\ddot{\vec{r}} \\ & \vec{v} = \dot{x}\vec{e}_x + \dot{y}\vec{e}_y + \dot{z}\vec{e}_z,\ \vec{B} = \alpha z\vec{e}_y + (B_0 + \alpha y)\vec{e}_z \end{aligned} \right.$$

$$\frac{\partial B_y}{\partial z} = \frac{\partial B_z}{\partial y} \Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{d}B_y}{\mathrm{d}z} = \alpha \Rightarrow \mathrm{d}B_y = \alpha\mathrm{d}z \Rightarrow \int_0^{B_y}\mathrm{d}B_y = \alpha\int_0^z\mathrm{d}z \Rightarrow B_y = \alpha z \tag{2.2}$$

$$\left\{ \begin{aligned} \ddot{x} &= \omega_0(1 + \frac{\alpha}{B_0}y)\dot{y} - \frac{q\alpha}{m}z\dot{z} \\ \ddot{y} &= -\omega_0(1 + \frac{\alpha}{B_0}y)\dot{x} \end{aligned} \right.$$

题六.

（1）$(m_{01}+m_{02})_{\min}=0$

实验室参照系：

当生成的两粒子均静止时，$m_{01}+m_{02}$ 最大，但违背动量守恒定律。

质心参照系：

当生成的两粒子均静止时，$m_{01}+m_{02}$ 最大，且不违背动量守恒定律。

$$v_{c}=\frac{\sum p}{\sum m}=\frac{\gamma_{0}m_{0}v_{0}}{m_{0}+\gamma_{0}m_{0}}=\frac{\gamma_{0}}{1+\gamma_{0}}v_{0}\quad(\gamma_{0}=1/\sqrt{1-v_{0}^{2}/c^{2}})$$

$$v_{0}=\frac{3}{5}c,\quad \gamma_{0}=\frac{5}{4}\Rightarrow v_{c}=\frac{1}{3}c,\quad \beta_{c}=\frac{1}{3},\quad \gamma_{c}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\beta_{c}^{2}}}=\frac{3\sqrt{2}}{4}$$

$$(m_{01}+m_{02})_{\max}=2\gamma_{C}m_{0}=\frac{3\sqrt{2}}{2}m_{0}$$

（2）

$$E^{\prime}=\gamma_{C}m_{0}c^{2}=\frac{3\sqrt{2}}{4}m_{0}c^{2}$$

$$E_{1}=\frac{1+\beta_{c}\cos\theta^{\prime}}{\sqrt{1-\beta_{c}^{2}}}E^{\prime}$$

质心参照系

$$E_{1,\max}=\sqrt{\frac{1+\beta_{C}}{1-\beta_{C}}}E'=\frac{3}{2}m_{0}c^{2}$$

$$E_{1,\min}=\sqrt{\frac{1-\beta_{c}}{1+\beta_{c}}}E^{\prime}=\frac{3}{4}m_{0}c^{2}$$

$$\frac{3}{4}m_{0}c^{2}\leq E_{1}\leq \frac{3}{2}m_{0}c^{2}$$

实验室参照系

$$\cos\theta_{1}=\frac{\beta_{c}+\cos\theta'}{1+\beta_{c}\cos\theta'},\ \sin\theta_{1}=\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta_{c}^{2}}\sin\theta'}{1+\beta_{c}\cos\theta'}$$

$$\cos(2\pi-\theta_{2})=\frac{\cos(\pi+\theta')+\beta_{c}}{1+\beta_{c}\cos(\pi+\theta')}$$

$$\cos\theta_{2}=\frac{\beta_{c}-\cos\theta^{\prime}}{1-\beta_{c}\cos\theta^{\prime}},\ \sin\theta_{2}=\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta_{c}^{2}}\sin\theta^{\prime}}{1-\beta_{c}\cos\theta^{\prime}}$$

质心参照系

$$\cos\alpha=\cos(\theta_1+\theta_2)=\cos\theta_1\cos\theta_2-\sin\theta_1\sin\theta_2=1-\frac{2(1-\beta_{c}^{2})}{1-\beta_{c}^{2}\cos^{2}\theta^{\prime}}$$

$$\theta^{\prime}=0,\pi\Rightarrow\cos\alpha_{\max}=-1,\alpha_{\max}=\pi$$

实验室参照系

$$\theta^{\prime}=\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}\Rightarrow\cos\alpha_{\min}=2\beta_{c}^{2}-1=-\frac{7}{9}\Rightarrow\alpha_{\min}=\pi-\arccos\frac{7}{9}$$

$$\pi-\arccos\frac{7}{9}\leq\alpha_{\min}\leq\pi$$

$$E^{\prime}=E_{0}^{\prime}=\gamma_{C}m_{0}c^{2}=\frac{3\sqrt{2}}{4}m_{0}c^{2}$$

$$E_{1}=\gamma_{c}(E'+v_{c}p'_{x})=\gamma_{c}(E'+v_{c}p'\cos\theta')$$

$$p'=p'_{0}=\gamma_c m_0 v_c=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}m_0 c$$

$$E_{1,\max}=\gamma_{c}(E'+v_{c}p')=\frac{5}{4}m_{0}c^{2}$$

$$E_{1,\min}=\gamma_{c}(E'-v_{c}p')=m_{0}c^{2}$$

$$v_{1,\max}=v_{0},\ v_{2,\min}=0$$

$$v_{1,\min}=0,\ v_{2,\max}=v_0$$

发生正碰时，两粒子交换速度。

质心参照系

实验室参照系

另解：

$$p^{2}=p_{1}^{2}+p_{2}^{2}+2p_{1}p_{2}\cos\alpha=(p_{1}+p_{2})^{2}-2p_{1}p_{2}(1-\cos\alpha)$$

$$\cos\alpha=1-\frac{(p_{1}+p_{2})^{2}-p^{2}}{2p_{1}p_{2}}$$

$$p_{1}+p_{2}=\frac{E_{1}+E_{2}}{c}=\frac{m_{0}c^{2}+\gamma_{0}m_{0}c^{2}}{c}=\frac{9}{4}m_{0}c$$

$$p=\gamma_{0}m_{0}v_{0}=\frac{3}{4}m_{0}c$$

$$p_{1}=p_{2}\Rightarrow\cos\alpha_{\min}=\frac{p^{2}}{2p_{1}^{2}}-1=\frac{2p^{2}}{(p_{1}+p_{2})^{2}}-1=-\frac{7}{9}$$

$$\alpha_{\min}=\pi-\arccos\frac{7}{9}$$

$$p_{2}=p+p_{1}\Rightarrow\cos\alpha_{\max}=-1\Rightarrow\alpha_{\max}=\pi$$

$$\pi-\arccos\frac{7}{9}\leq\alpha_{\min}\leq\pi$$

$$p_{1x}=\gamma_{c}(p_{x}^{\prime}+\frac{v_{c}E^{\prime}}{c^{2}})=\gamma_{c}(p^{\prime}\cos\theta^{\prime}+\frac{v_{c}E^{\prime}}{c^{2}})$$

$$p_{1y}=p_{y}^{\prime}=p^{\prime}\sin\theta^{\prime}$$

$$\tan\theta_{1}=\frac{p_{1y}}{p_{1x}}=\frac{p^{\prime}\sin\theta^{\prime}}{\gamma_{C}(p^{\prime}\cos\theta^{\prime}+v_{C}E^{\prime}/c^{2})}=\frac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}\frac{\sin\theta^{\prime}}{1+\cos\theta^{\prime}}$$

质心参照系

$$\tan(-\theta_2)=\frac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}\frac{\sin(\pi+\theta^{\prime})}{1+\cos(\pi+\theta^{\prime})}\Rightarrow\tan\theta_2=\frac{2\sqrt{2}}{3}\frac{\sin\theta^{\prime}}{1-\cos\theta^{\prime}}$$

$$\tan\alpha=\tan(\theta_{1}+\theta_{2})=\frac{\tan\theta_{1}+\tan\theta_{2}}{1-\tan\theta_{1}\tan\theta_{2}}=\frac{2\gamma_{c}}{\gamma_{c}^{2}-1}\frac{1}{\sin\theta_{1}}$$

$$\Theta^{\prime}\to 0,\tan\alpha_{\max}\to\infty,\alpha_{\max}\to\frac{\pi}{2}$$

实验室参照系

$$\theta^{\prime}=\frac{\pi}{2},\tan\alpha_{\min}=\frac{2\gamma_{c}}{\gamma_{c}^{2}-1}=12\sqrt{2},\alpha_{\min}=\arctan(12\sqrt{2})$$

$$\arctan(12\sqrt{2})\leq\alpha_{\min}<\pi/2$$

（1）刚好翻转：$F\equiv F_{\mathrm{c}}$

此时棱柱筒相对于平板静止，弹力 $N$ 的作用点刚好在 $A$ 点。

$$F_{c}=(M+m)a_{0}$$

$$\tau_{A}=mgR\sin\alpha-ma_{0}R\cos\alpha=0$$

$$F_{c}=(M+m)g\tan\alpha=(M+m)g\tan\frac{\pi}{N}$$

$F$ 的范围：$F<(M+m)g\tan\frac{\pi}{N}$

只要 $F>(M+m)g\tan\frac{\pi}{N}$ 时，棱柱筒一定会翻转（质心 $C$ 会越过最高点）

$$[(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\theta]R\frac{\mathrm{d}\omega^{2}}{\mathrm{d}\theta}+2mR\omega^{2}\sin\theta\cos\theta=2(m+M)g\sin\theta-2F\cos\theta$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}\theta}\{[(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\theta]R\omega^{2}\}=2(m+M)g\sin\theta-2F\cos\theta$$

$$\mathrm{d}\{[(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\theta]R\omega^{2}\}=[2(m+M)g\sin\theta-2F\cos\theta]\mathrm{d}\theta$$

$$\omega_{1}^{2}=\frac{4F\sin\alpha}{[(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha]R}\Rightarrow\omega_{1}=\sqrt{\frac{4\sin\alpha}{(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}}\frac{F}{R}\quad(\alpha=\frac{\pi}{N})$$

（2）

$$J_{c}=N[\frac{1}{12}\frac{m}{N}(2R\sin\alpha)^{2}+\frac{m}{N}(R\cos\alpha)^{2}]=(1-\frac{2}{3}\sin^{2}\alpha)mR^{2}\Rightarrow\gamma=1-\frac{2}{3}\sin^{2}\alpha$$

（3）

$$F-f=Ma_{0}$$

$$ma_{0}-f=ma_{\mathrm{C}}\cos\theta+ma_{\mathrm{C}}\sin\theta$$

$$ma_{0}R\cos\theta-mgR\sin\theta=J_{A}^{\prime}\beta$$

$$a_{\Omega}=R\beta,\ a_{\Omega}=R\omega^{2},\ J_{A}=J_{C}+mR^{2}=(1+\gamma)mR^{2}$$

$$\beta=\frac{F\cos\theta-(m+M)g\sin\theta+mR\omega^{2}\sin\theta\cos\theta}{(1+\gamma)(m+M)R-mR\cos^{2}\theta}$$

$$[(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\theta]R\frac{\mathrm{d}\omega^{2}}{\mathrm{d}\theta}+2mR\sin\theta\cos\theta\omega^{2}=2(m+M)g\sin\theta-2F\cos\theta$$

另解：质心系中的动能定理：

$$W_{(M+m)g}^{\prime}=0$$

$$W_{F}^{\prime}=F\cdot 2x_{M}^{\prime}=F\frac{2mR\sin\alpha}{m+M}$$

$$\int\mathrm{d}W_{N}^{\prime}=-N\mathrm{d}y_{C}$$

$$\mathrm{d}W_{N}^{\prime}=-\mathrm{d}\left[\frac{1}{2}(m+M)v_{cy}^{2}\right]=-\mathrm{d}\left[\frac{1}{2}(m+M)(\frac{mR}{m+M}\cos\theta)^{2}\right]$$

$$-\frac{1}{2}\frac{m^{2}R^{2}}{m+M}\mathrm{d}(\omega\sin\theta)^{2}$$

$$W_{N}^{\prime}=-\frac{1}{2}\frac{m^{2}R^{2}\omega_{1}^{2}\sin^{2}\alpha}{m+M}$$

$$E_{k,0}^{\prime}=0$$

$$E_{k,1}^{\prime}=\frac{1}{2}J_{c}\omega_{1}^{2}+\frac{1}{2}\mu(R\omega_{1})^{2}=\frac{1}{2}mR^{2}\omega_{1}^{2}\frac{(1+\gamma)M+\gamma m}{m+M}\quad(J_{c}=\gamma mR^{2},\ \mu=\frac{mM}{m+M})$$

$$W_{F}^{\prime}+W_{N}^{\prime}+W_{(m+M)g}^{\prime}=E_{k,1}^{\prime}-E_{k,0}^{\prime}$$

$$\frac{2mFR\sin\alpha}{m+M}-\frac{1}{2}\frac{m^{2}R^{2}\omega_{1}^{2}\sin^{2}\alpha}{m+M}=\frac{1}{2}mR^{2}\omega_{1}^{2}\frac{(1+\gamma)M+\gamma m}{m+M}$$

$$\omega_{1}=\sqrt{\frac{4\sin\alpha}{(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}}\quad(\alpha=\frac{\pi}{N})$$

（5）

$$\omega_{n+1}^{2}=\omega_{n}^{\prime 2}+\frac{4\sin\alpha}{(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}\frac{F}{R}$$

$$\omega_{n+1}^{\prime}=\frac{(\gamma+\cos 2\alpha)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}{(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}\omega_{n+1}=\frac{(\gamma+\cos 2\alpha)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}{(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}\sqrt{1+\gamma}\sqrt{\frac{4\sin\alpha}{(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}\frac{F}{R}}\quad(\alpha=\frac{\pi}{N})$$

（4）地面系中水平动量守恒，对瞬间与碰撞点 $A'$ 重合的点角动量守恒：

$$\left\{\begin{aligned}Mv_{0}+mv_{0}-mR\omega_{1}\cos\alpha=Mv_{0}^{\prime}+mv_{0}^{\prime}-mR\omega_{1}^{\prime}\cos\alpha\\J_{c}\omega_{1}+mR\omega_{1}\cdot R\sin(\frac{\pi}{2}-2\alpha)-mv_{0}R\sin(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha)=J_{c}\omega_{1}^{\prime}+mR\omega_{1}^{\prime}\cdot R-mv_{0}^{\prime}R\sin(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha)\\J_{c}=\gamma mR^{2}\end{aligned}\right.$$

$$\omega_{1}^{\prime}=\frac{(\gamma+\cos2\alpha)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}{(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}\omega_{1}=\frac{(\gamma+\cos2\alpha)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha}{[(1+\gamma)(m+M)-m\cos^{2}\alpha]^{3/2}}\sqrt{\frac{4F\sin\alpha}{R}}\quad(\alpha=\frac{\pi}{N})$$

（6）

$$N>1,\alpha\to 0,\cos\alpha\approx 1,\sin\alpha\approx\alpha,\gamma=1-\frac{2}{3}\sin^2\alpha\approx 1$$

$$\omega_{n+1}^{\prime}=\sqrt{\omega_{n}^{\prime 2}+\frac{4\alpha F}{(m+2M)R}}$$

$$\omega_{n+1}^{\prime 2}=\omega_{n}^{\prime 2}+\frac{4\alpha F}{(m+2M)R}$$

$$\omega_{N}^{'2}=N\frac{4\alpha F}{(m+2M)R}=\frac{4\pi F}{(m+2M)R}$$

$$\omega_{N}^{\prime}=\sqrt{\frac{4\pi F}{(m+2M)R}}$$

（7）

把正棱柱筒视为圆筒：

$$F-f=Ma_{0}$$

$$ma_{0}-f=ma_{C}$$

$$ma_{0}R=J_{A}\beta$$

$$a_{c}=R\beta,\ J_{A}=J_{C}+mR^{2}=2mR^{2}$$

$$\beta=\frac{F}{(m+2M)R}$$

$$\omega^{2}=2\beta\cdot2\pi\Rightarrow\omega=\sqrt{\frac{4\pi F}{(m+2M)R}}$$

与 $N\gg 1$ 时的 $\omega$ 一致。
